attr.title: Killer Instinct (Arcade) — R36S ARM64
attr.desc: Independent experimental R36S ARM64 port of kilnan's static Killer Instinct recompilation. GLES2/NEON, Audio Smooth, 4:3.
attr.inst: Provide your own lawful kinst.zip (L1.5D BIOS) and kinst.chd in killerinstinct/gamedata. Game code is statically recompiled; review legal notice and distribution rights.
